# R4.2a — CI cost and wait, phase 1: one PR run per head, docs-only fast path, spike on full runs, full run per gate

Implements `docs/tickets/151a_R4.2a__ci-fast-path-and-full-run-cadence.md`
(run-time insert, row 151a) under GATE DECISIONS `CI insert` **D1–D7**
(2026-10-20, LEDGER.md). CI infrastructure only; no requirement ids
(`no_req_reason: operator-decided CI cost and wait insert`). Stamps: D1–D7 and
**ADR-0220** (the "CI-runnable (non-gating)" spike consequence kept by the
dispatch runs). Decision record: **ADR-0362**.

## Summary
- `push` now runs on `main` only — a chain branch gets CI only through its PR
  (one `pull_request` run per head; was ≈ 2 per head). `workflow_dispatch`
  added; concurrency is event-scoped and a dispatch is never cancelled.
  `permissions: contents: read, actions: read`.
- A **fail-closed docs-only fast path** decided inside the job: the check
  keeps its name `build · test · fmt · drift` and its `success` conclusion.
  The fingerprint is the sha256 of `git ls-tree -r -z --full-tree HEAD` minus
  `docs/`/`research/` entries — the job's own checkout, never
  `pull_request.head.sha`. A `fast` answer needs all of D-B4 (a)–(e), ending
  in an unexpired, same-repository `ci-anchor-v1-<job>-<RUNNER_OS>-<fp>`
  artifact; any error answers `full` with a `ci-full-path` notice naming the
  reason.
- The S2 spike and its sheet upload run only on `workflow_dispatch` full runs
  (`continue-on-error` kept).
- Full runs per **D4**: at GATE-G7, GATE-G6, before H7's tag, and this
  ticket's own final code head — never per ticket.
- **D6 fallback cut taken** — production measured **413** changed lines after
  deliverable 4 (≥ 330 trigger): the full-run reader (`full-run.sh` + test)
  moved into L4.3 (164r) by dated note; the step-mode lint is never cut.
  Post-cut production **399** / tests **350** (budgets 400/450; stops 600/675).

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — triggers, permissions, concurrency, the

- `scripts/ci/check-ci-gating.sh` — the step-mode lint + readers scan;

- `scripts/ci/test-fast-path.sh`, `scripts/ci/test-check-ci-gating.sh`,

- `AGENTS.md`, `docs/adr/ADR-0362-…` + regenerated index.
- Dated `(R4.2a, ADR-0362)` banners on `164p`, `164q`, `164r`, `165`,
